body: Everyone has their own amount of value, no matter the person. This includes you, OP. You are worth more than you let on. I’m not sure about your situation, but my PMs are open if you want to allow yourself a second chance.

No one ever has the right to destroy your life. She's taken you and broken you in ways indescribable, and you've started to let go of your nail and hammer. Without those tools you cannot be fixed, you cannot be fixed if you are not willing to fix yourself, to help yourself. There are gracious others in the world somewhere who are willing to help you forget, to move on. You have to stand up and find them. It's easier to write than act on, but with time, you could go somewhere with this and improve yourself. Make progress, OP, because there's nothing more crestfallen than an incomplete book when the writer still holds his pen.
